prompt: Design a polished responsive OpenParking parking administrator dashboard. VISUAL DESIGN ONLY, not application architecture. Existing React 18 TypeScript Vite app uses Lucide icons, Recharts, vanilla CSS, Zustand, authenticated ParkingAdmin/SystemAdmin users. Preserve these navigation destinations: Dashboard /, Parking Zones /zones, AI Enforcement /ai-enforcement, Analytics /analytics, Hardware Logs /hardware, Permits Review /permits, Settings /settings, Slot Mapping /slot-mapping, Book Parking /book-parking. Create an elegant light workspace with a dark forest green sidebar, emerald accents, off-white canvas, white bordered cards, subtle shadows, generous whitespace, clean sans typography. Brand P parking mark and OpenParking wordmark. Sidebar group OPERATIONS and MANAGEMENT, active dashboard pill, account and sign out footer. Header breadcrumb Workspace / Dashboard, currency indicator and user initials. Page header Parking at a glance, descriptive subtitle and links to Slot Mapping and Book Parking. Dashboard actual supported functionality: period selector 7/30/90 days, refresh; four metrics total sessions (active/completed sublabels), parking revenue and penalties, average stay duration, enforcement overstays and pending workflows; two-column daily revenue line chart and live occupancy by zone with green/amber/red horizontal progress bars and occupied/available/reserved counts; weekly violations bar chart and AI workflow status approved/auto-approved/pending/rejected/failed; pending AI workflow approval queue with objective, workflow type, timestamp, session/zone identifier and Approve/Reject buttons. Loading, empty and network error states must be visually accommodated. Do not invent search, notification, export, sensor online claims, growth comparisons or unsupported controls. On mobile sidebar collapses using accessible menu button, metrics stack, charts stack and approval actions wrap. This is visual reference only; runtime will use existing authenticated backend endpoints, no generated data or logic.
